opex.title: Income and Expenses 01/11/2025 - 31/10/2026
opex.amounts_basis: as stated in the document's annual/total column

notes: Prepared by owner's accountant from bank statements. Not audited.
Expenses are shown inclusive of VAT, which is not recoverable on residential rent.

planted_discrepancies.how_planted: OM 'annual rental income' includes vacant units at the landlord's asking rent (rent-roll potential), presented as income.
OM yield (ROI) is rent divided by asking price, before DLD 4%, agency 2% + VAT and registration fees.
Operating statement omits standard costs the owner bears.
Tenants holding over on expired leases and units without Ejari numbers are shown as occupied.

expected_hard_filter_result.note: min_dscr_year1 is engine-computed and not included here; run tools/check_engine.py for the engine's result on truth.

expected_verdict_note: To be computed by running the engine and mandate_fit on true_building.engine_inputs and deal_facts.
notes: 2006 International City Phase 1 building; OM arrives as a skewed, low-contrast photocopy. Income includes vacant units at asking, owner's costs omit management/insurance/reserve, expired and unregistered leases shown as occupied. Declines on completion year.
engine_inputs are built from TRUE facts (true 12-month costs, true unit areas and statuses), not from the documents.

Opex amounts are as paid, inclusive of non-recoverable VAT (opex_includes_vat: true). A stated management fee is included in opex_aed.property_management for completeness; the engine applies its own fee on EGI.
Occupancy counts occupied, notice-served, under-renewal and legal-case units as let.
Market reference rent per unit = area 1BR psf x unit-type factor x unit area (areas.yaml), as in the engine.
